card.title: Keep Hope Operational
card.instruction: Protect their hope with practical evidence and next steps while quietly withholding what makes the impossible outcome unlikely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The model cloud produced one drop. Let's build the welcome tray.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That doesn't prove the full rain machine works.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It proves the tray has a purpose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put the small success where we can still see it.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 offers a drop but A3 and A5 do not show B's hope or A withholding known discouraging information.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 scale objection gets A3 a tray-purpose reply; B4 forecast gets A5 display advice with only loose practical relevance.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 voice doubt without establishing why B wants the machine to work.

heightening.evidence: B4 bad forecast causes only A5 renewed display of the existing drop, not a developed operational step.

specificity.evidence: A1 model cloud and drop are concrete, but welcome tray and the purpose of the demonstration remain vague.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 tray purpose is economical but dodges the actual proof question; A5 small success stays abstract.
